form.hint: Changes apply to new battles; a battle already in progress uses the rules fixed at its start

validation.initiativeOrder: Minimum initiative is greater than the maximum
validation.criticalsOrder: Fumble must be lower than crit

criticals.effectsHint: Doubling damage on a crit is a table effect (“{name}”). If you turn off the tables or this effect, a crit is only marked, with no extra damage.
criticals.doubleDiceHint: A crit doubles the damage dice (weapon, spell attack); modifiers are not doubled.

initiative.modeRoll: d20 + Dexterity modifier at battle start

outOfCombat.longRestHitDice: 2024 rules: a long rest restores all hit dice (otherwise half)

encounters.balance: Balance by the 5e XP budget (otherwise — HOMM fair fight)
encounters.autoXpHint: Works only together with “Experience by the 5e table” on the “Out of combat” tab.

items.enabled: 5e items: attunement, wearing from the stash, consumables in battle

spellIngredients.enabled: Spell ingredients: check and spend material components when casting
spellIngredients.autoPay: Cover missing ingredients from the wallet

morale.label: Morale
morale.description: A d10 check at the start of a turn: positive morale gives a chance of an extra turn, negative makes the unit skip. The cap is the maximum value of ±N.

criticals.label: Critical hits
criticals.description: The crit and fumble thresholds on d20 and the critical effect tables.

formulas.label: Formulas
formulas.description: Save DC = base + proficiency + modifier; the proficiency bonus grows with the hero's level.

heroScaling.label: Hero power
heroScaling.description: Hero damage dice by level and the HP formula.

initiative.label: Initiative
initiative.description: The allowed range of a hero's static initiative and the mode: static or d20 + Dexterity.

defaultAttacks.label: Default attacks
defaultAttacks.description: Names of the attacks a hero gets without a weapon.

saves.label: Saving throws
saves.description: Proficiency in a hero's saving throws (from the character sheet). Advantage, disadvantage and auto-fail always come from conditions and abilities.

deathSaves.label: Death saves
deathSaves.description: A hero at 0 HP rolls d20 on their turn: 3 successes — stable, 3 failures — death, a 20 — 1 HP. Units at 0 HP die.

concentration.label: Concentration
concentration.description: Concentration spells: one per caster; damage requires a Constitution saving throw DC max(10, ½ damage).

actions.label: 5e actions
actions.description: Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Stand up, Grapple, Shove; opportunity attacks; HOMM "retaliation" (the target's automatic reply, off in 5e). The 2014/2024 variant sets the Grapple and Shove formula.

classes.label: Classes
classes.description: A character's class and subclass as campaign content: hit die, saving throws, caster type, features by level; multiclassing. HP is the average of the hit dice, slots follow the 5e multiclass table and pact. A character without classes is calculated as before.

conditions.label: 5e conditions
conditions.description: The 5e condition menu for the DM in battle and the 5e condition group in the ability editor; the 2014 or 2024 exhaustion table.

outOfCombat.label: Out of combat
outOfCombat.description: Heroes' resources between battles (HP, slots, pact, per-rest charges, exhaustion), short and long rest, hit dice, experience by the 5e table, inspiration. Off — every battle starts with full resources.

encounters.label: Encounters
encounters.description: Battle balance: the HOMM "fair fight" (enemy HP and damage scaling) or the 5e XP budget by unit CR (DMG 2014 or 2024 thresholds, no scaling). Auto XP: after a victory the defeated enemies' XP is split equally among the heroes (requires "Experience by the 5e table").

items.label: Items
items.description: 5e magic items: attunement (at most N items), "Artifact" and "Ring" slot items work straight from the stash, consumables (potions, ammo) are used in battle and spent afterwards. Properties, non-unique gear and charges are content properties and do not depend on this switch.

spellIngredients.label: Spell ingredients
spellIngredients.description: Costly or consumed material components are checked when casting in battle and spent from the hero's inventory items; a shortfall can be covered with gold from the wallet. Non-consumed components only have to be in the inventory and are never spent. Spending is kept after the battle only with the "persist resources" out-of-combat rule on. Existing spells without ingredients are unchanged.

customConditions.confirm: Spells and abilities that apply it will stop working.
customConditions.usageHint: The condition was not deleted. Remove it from these places first.
